question: Which omitted layer bands are required to close the live cue-source-to-compiled-reader graph?
selection_rule: Among jointly feasible non-all arms, select the fewest allowed sites, breaking ties by frozen arm order. Joint feasibility requires, under both frozen cross-fits: coordinate minimum signed projection >=0.75 and mean residual <=0.20; target minimum signed projection >=0.80 and worst residual <=0.15; control maximum normalized margin RMS <=0.10, median full-vocabulary KL <=0.02, and top-1 flip fraction <=0.05.

predictions.pred_a_authority_self_clamp_finiteness_a: all authorities replay, top20 agrees across fits, no-source self-clamp is exact, all reported values are finite, and <=72 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_a_non_all_arm_is_jointly_feasible: at least one arm other than all satisfies every coordinate, target, and control threshold under both fits
predictions.pred_c_selected_arm_is_crossfit_stable: the selected arm has even/odd minimum-coordinate projections within 0.05 and per-task final projections within 0.05
predictions.pred_d_selected_arm_is_strictly_pruned: the selected arm exists and permits fewer than all 110 upstream components
predictions.pred_e_addback_localizes_a_required_band: at least one single-band arm improves the top-only minimum coordinate projection by >=0.15 under both fits

decision: A passing selected arm becomes the dependency-complete candidate graph. If no non-all arm is feasible, use the arm table to replace coarse layer bands with component-level dependency addback; the all arm is a diagnostic ceiling only.
